objective: To monitor daily orders (DTP) per date, location and DTP type together with the status of every cycle (Cycle 1 - Cycle 5).
To display the order detail per cycle: truck, driver, route, Container Number, activity time and supporting files (Foto Surat Jalan, Finish Cycle Foto, Surat Jalan ELIPS).
To let IP Admin assign an order to a truck number (Order Release) and trigger the SA / PAS process.
To let Supplier with LP Admin access process their own orders manually: Order Release -> Pickup Container -> Finish Cycle -> Finish Order.
To restrict Supplier users to their own data only and keep a status history (who, when, from/to status, reason) for every status change.

operation.text: 5.1 Access Control
The data scope and allowed actions follow the login user role:

rows: Assign Truck, Process to SA, Process to PAS
Order Release, Pickup Container, Finish Cycle, Finish Order (Reason mandatory)
Orders of the truck used at login

operation.text: The supplier restriction applies to the Order List, search, paging total, Export and Order Detail. Opening an order outside the scope shows message no. 4.
5.2 Search Operation
5.2.1 Initial Display
'Date From' = system date, 'Date To' blank, 'From Loc.' / 'To Loc.' = <Select>, Tab = ALL, Search box blank.
Order List shows orders within the user data scope matching the initial criteria, sorted by No. Order ascending, 10 rows per page.
'Last Sync at' shows the data load time.
5.2.2 Button Operation
User clicks 'Find'.

items: If Date From and Date To are filled and Date From > Date To, display message no. 1. Stop.
Retrieve orders by Date From, Date To, From Loc., To Loc., selected DTP tab and Search text within the user data scope.
If there is no data retrieved, show empty grid with message no. 2.

operation.text: User clicks 'Clear': reset all criteria (including Search) and show all orders within the user data scope.
User clicks a DTP tab: filter by DTP Type; ALL = no filter. Key-in on 'Search' filters immediately.
User clicks 'Refresh': reload the list with latest data and update 'Last Sync at'.
User clicks a column header: sort by that column; click again to reverse. Order Status sorts by workflow sequence.

User clicks 'Export' > 'Export ke Excel (.csv)': export all rows matching current criteria (not only current page) with Driver, Cycle 1-5 status + container, Order Status, SA Approved At and PO Number. If no row, display message no. 3. 'Print / PDF' prints the list.
User clicks 'Kolom': show / hide the checked columns (screen only).
5.3 Order Detail
User clicks the Action icon: open Order Detail modal (Summary, Action, Cycle n sections, Status History).
Cycle sections are shown for every existing cycle, Cycle 1 first. Activity time blank is shown as 'Belum dilakukan'.

Files: 'View' Foto Surat Jalan enabled after Pickup Container; Finish Cycle Foto after Finish Cycle. 'Surat Jalan ELIPS' and 'PDF' enabled after Start Cycle. If pop-up is blocked when clicking 'PDF', display message no. 5.
Status History lists every status change and failed SA/PAS attempt, latest first.
Driver actions (Start Order, Pickup Container, Finish Cycle, Start Next Cycle, Finish Order) are done in the Driver App and are shown on this screen after Refresh.
5.4 Status Definition

rows: DTP created by Check & Submit (Planning Order screen)
IP Admin assigns the order to a truck number, or LP Admin does Order Release (Reason, Driver)
Driver starts the order (Driver App), or LP Admin Pickup Container on Order Release
Driver or LP Admin finishes the order
Order successfully processed to SA; SA timestamp saved
Order successfully processed to PAS and PO Number received
Cycle 1 created together with the DTP
Driver starts the order (Cycle 1) or starts the next cycle (Cycle 2, 3, ...)
Container picked up; Container Number recorded

operation.text: Container Number must be recorded on every cycle. Maximum 5 cycles per order (TBD, OP-07).
5.5 Status Transition Rules
An action is allowed only from the status below; otherwise display message no. 7. A role not listed gets message no. 8.

rows: Order Release (auto Start Cycle) or last cycle Finish Cycle (auto new cycle)
Start Daily Order + Finish Cycle, cycles < 5
Start Daily Order + last cycle Finish Cycle

operation.text: 5.6 Button Operation (Action Input modal)

Common for all actions on 'Submit': 1. If a mandatory field is blank, display message no. 6. Stop. 2. Check role and status (5.5); if not allowed, message no. 7 / 8. Stop. 3. Run the action validation below. 4. Update the order / cycle (Data Edit Mapping), insert status history (user, role, time, from/to status, reason, note), close the modal, refresh Order Detail and Order List and display message no. 10. If the record was changed by another user, display message no. 9.
5.6.1 Assign Truck (IP Admin)

items: If the truck is not registered or not owned by the order Trucking Company, display message no. 11. Stop.
If truck license date < order date, display message no. 12. Stop.
If the truck is assigned to another order in Order Release / Start Daily Order with the same date and shift, display message no. 13. Stop.
Otherwise set Truck No and Order Status = Order Release.

operation.text: 5.6.2 Order Release (LP Admin) - Reason, Driver

items: If Reason has fewer than 10 characters, display message no. 14. Stop.
If the driver is not registered, inactive or not owned by the order supplier, display message no. 15. Stop.
If the order has no truck and the driver has no registered truck, display message no. 16. Stop.
Otherwise set Driver, Truck No (driver's registered truck when blank) and Order Status = Order Release.

operation.text: 5.6.3 Pickup Container (LP Admin) - Reason, Container Number

items: Reason check as 5.6.2 (message no. 14).
If Order Status is Order Release and Driver is blank, display message no. 21. Stop.
If the last cycle is Finish Cycle and the order already has 5 cycles, display message no. 22. Stop.
Container Number: not ISO 6346 format -> message no. 17; wrong check digit -> no. 18; used by another cycle of the same order -> no. 19; in Pickup Container on another order -> no. 20. Stop.
From Order Release: set Order Status = Start Daily Order and Cycle 1 Start Date = system date. After Finish Cycle: create the next cycle with Start Date = system date.
Set Container No, Cycle Status = Pickup Container, Pickup Date = system date.

operation.text: 5.6.4 Finish Cycle (LP Admin) - Reason

items: Reason check (message no. 14). If Container No of the cycle is blank, display message no. 23. Stop.
Set Cycle Status = Finish Cycle, Finish Date = system date.

operation.text: 5.6.5 Finish Order (LP Admin) - Reason

items: Reason check (message no. 14). If any cycle has no Container No, display message no. 23. Stop.
Set Order Status = Finish Daily Order. If actual cycles < planned cycles, note 'Actual x of planned y cycles' in history (allowed, TBD OP-06).

operation.text: 5.6.6 Process to SA / Process to PAS (IP Admin)

items: Process to SA: if any cycle is not Finish Cycle or has no Container No, display message no. 24. Stop. Send to SA; if failed, keep status, log failure (Logging no. 2) and display message no. 25. If successful, set Order Status = SA Approved and SA Approved Date.

Process to PAS: send to PAS; if no PO Number is returned, keep SA Approved, log failure (Logging no. 3) and display message no. 26. If PO Number format is invalid, display message no. 27. If successful, set Order Status = SA Approved with PO Number, PO Number and PO Received Date.
Whether SA / PAS is also run by a scheduled batch is TBD (OP-10).

operation.text: 5.7 Related Functions (separate UISS)

Planning Order screen - DTP Check & Submit: Date, Type, Trucking Comp., Shift, From/To Loc., Renban (5 digits, unique per supplier + date + shift), Planned Cycle (1-5) mandatory; date not in the past; From <> To. Creates order Planning Order / DTP Creation Release.

Driver App - Login with User ID, Truck No. and truck license date: user ID registered and active, truck registered and owned by the driver supplier, license date equals master and not expired. Driver sees only orders of that truck; Start Order only when the truck has no other order in Start Daily Order.
Driver App - Start Order, Pickup Container (Container Number mandatory), Finish Cycle, Start Next Cycle, Finish Order follow the rules in 5.5 and 5.6 without Reason.
